name: Mizoguchi Hiyori
source:
"Victim #2"

An ordinary female student with a somewhat lively personality who falls victim to the protagonist’s magic.

She always has a bright, cheerful expression. She’s always hanging out with her friends and sometimes hangs out with Natsume.

Whenever she falls victim to the protagonist’s magic, her friends are always right there watching, putting her in a very embarrassing situation.

[From [url=http://mbstruth.com/dmc/cha/cha09.html]official site[/url]]
